entries.note: The tree, blob and revision writers encode the recorder's delta nodes; the file is the recorder's own and moves under it when the capture half is extracted (Phase 4). `assignIds`/`TreeInputBlock` are the current-state parts that stay.

`explicitWalker` parses the recorder's node forms for the mark the retention squash and `ReachMarker` share; M7 roots the core's half on current state and leaves the walk to the recorder (Phase 3). `sweepUnreachable` already takes the mark through `HistoryRecorder.markReachable`.
